description.en: Create editable PPTX presentations with local document tools and optional platform image generation and cloud narration. Includes PyMuPDF (AGPL), downloaded from upstream at deployment.
description.zh-CN: 生成可编辑PPTX，文档工具在成员实例运行，生图与云端旁白可选地由平台代执行。包含部署时从上游下载的PyMuPDF（AGPL）。

identity.en: Documents, Edge narration and image search run in the member workspace. Optional images and cloud narration use platform-held provider credentials; keys never enter the member instance. Provider calls consume the team quota.
identity.zh-CN: 文档、Edge旁白与图库搜索在成员空间运行。可选生图与云端旁白使用平台保存的后端凭据，key不进入成员实例，调用消耗团队额度。

items.name: ppt-master-tools
items.description: Editable presentations with platform-provided Python libraries and optional delegated media.
items.note:
Follow the upstream ppt-master workflow and keep all outputs in the member project. The platform provides the locked Python libraries through python3 and pandoc on PATH; do not install or update them. Local preview, confirmation, annotation and specification-review web pages are unavailable. Use generated files and command-line checks instead.
Image generation: invoke python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/image_gen.py" from the project directory. The platform forwards this script to delegated execution. Configure IMAGE_BACKEND and only that provider's key, with optional model/base URL overrides, in the catalog wizard. All backend fields can be skipped. Never put the team key in member environment variables or .env files. A disabled/unavailable execution (exit 125) means use image_search.py or finish with native shapes/text and no generated images. Member-owned OPENAI_* variables remain member-owned; they are never the platform key. Start with 512px, one image per call; for manifests use concurrency=1 and split into small batches within the existing time limit.
Cloud narration: use python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/cloud_notes_to_audio.py" with an explicit --provider elevenlabs|minimax|qwen|cosyvoice and that provider's variables configured in the wizard. This alias delegates the unchanged notes_to_audio.py source. No cloud key is required for local Edge narration: use the original python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/notes_to_audio.py" --provider edge in the member instance. image_search.py also stays local. Cloud providers still validate their own required settings; leaving unrelated backend fields empty is supported.
Produce editable PPTX using the upstream native/SVG workflow, not slide screenshots. PyMuPDF (including its associated packages) is AGPL software. These Python dependencies are downloaded from upstream at deployment; the catalog and platform do not redistribute their package bytes. Review the upstream license before use.
